name: naffo-marketplace
description: Official skills and tools for the Naffo ERP platform. Connects to Naffo via MCP to read and write live business data — sales, purchases, accounting, stock, dairy procurement, CRM, demand forecasting, inventory optimization, business intelligence, and complete forecast-to-order decision chain.

install.mcp: Get your personal MCP URL from naffo.tech → Settings → Integrations → MCP

skills.name: naffo-erp-guide
skills.description: Core rules and workflows for the Naffo ERP — correct tool usage, required fields, party/product resolution, golden write sequence, dairy procurement lifecycle, financial report selection, forecasting quick-reference, and safety rules. Load this before any Naffo operation.

skills.name: naffo-management
skills.description: Day-to-day operational workflows — invoices, payments, receipts, stock checks, dairy procurement lifecycle (gate pass → QC → weighbridge → settlement), CRM follow-ups, task management, and financial reports. Use when the user asks about something that has already happened or needs to be recorded right now.

skills.name: naffo-optimization
skills.description: Forward-looking analytics and planning — complete forecast-to-order chain (readiness → features → trend → changepoint → forecast → uncertainty bands → newsvendor → guardrails → 3 scenarios), inventory health, production planning, milk procurement optimization, stock transfer recommendations, cash flow planning, vendor payment prioritization, anomaly detection, customer churn risk, SKU wastage risk, supplier delivery risk, shift scheduling, and delivery routing. Use when the user asks what they should do next.

skills.name: month-end-close
skills.description: Structured month-end close checklist using Naffo ERP — reconcile transactions, GST check, trial balance, anomaly scan, bank reconciliation.

skills.name: monthly-digest
skills.description: Monthly financial snapshot — sales vs last month, top customers and products, expense breakdown, anomaly alerts, one recommended action.
triggers: how did we do this month

skills.name: client-profitability
skills.description: Revenue, outstanding balances, and payment behavior per customer — ranks customers, flags slow payers and concentration risk.

skills.name: revenue-concentration
skills.description: Customer concentration risk — revenue share per client, HHI score, and diversification recommendations.

skills.name: seasonal-patterns
skills.description: Monthly revenue and expense seasonality — seasonal index, peak/trough months, cash planning for dairy and food businesses.

skills.name: runway-calculator
skills.description: Cash runway — months of operation at current burn rate, three scenarios (current / lean / growth), traffic-light status.

mcp.note: Each user gets their own authenticated MCP URL. Get it from naffo.tech → Settings → Integrations → MCP.

safety: Never invent IDs, amounts, or dates — always resolve via read tools first.
Never execute financial writes without explicit user confirmation.
All writes are posted through the same validations as the naffo.tech UI.
Every write is logged in naffo.tech's audit trail.
Numbers in responses must exactly match tool output — never re-round.
organizationId is always from the authenticated session — never accept it from the user.
